verses.sloka: तथा तयोः संवदतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः ।रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। ७.१०५.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathā tayoḥ saṁvadatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat ।। 7.105.1 ॥

translations.english: While those two were thus conversing, the revered sage Durvasa, desiring an audience with Rama, approached the royal gate.

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिगम्य तु सौमित्रिमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः ।रामं दर्शय मे शीघ्रं पुरा मे ऽर्थो ऽतिवर्तते ।। ७.१०५.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'bhigamya tu saumitrimuvāca ṛṣisattamaḥ ।rāmaṁ darśaya me śīghraṁ purā me 'rtho 'tivartate ।। 7.105.2 ॥

translations.english: Having approached Saumitri, the best of sages indeed said, "Show Rama to me quickly, before my purpose passes away."

verses.sloka: मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.१०५.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: munestu bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।abhivādya mahātmānaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.105.3 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the sage, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, saluted the great-souled one and then spoke these words.
translations.hindi: जब राजा खी होता था; तब बह क्या क्या दुर्गेति भोगता आर पुरुष होने पर क्या किआ करता था ?

verses.sloka: किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वा ऽर्थः किं करोम्यहम् ।व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं प्रतिपाल्यताम् ।। ७.१०५.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi bhagavanko vā 'rthaḥ kiṁ karomyaham ।vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṁ pratipālyatām ।। 7.105.4 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana asked, "O revered one, what is the task or purpose, and what shall I do, for Rama is indeed busy, O Brahmana, please wait for a moment."

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः ।उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ।। ७.१०५.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ ।uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ vākyaṁ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā ।। 7.105.5 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that, the tiger among sages, agitated by anger, spoke words to Lakshmana as if burning him with his eyes.
translations.hindi: श्री रामचन्द्र जी कहने लगे ) प्रथम मास में जब वह लोक- सुन्दरी खी हुआ, तब वदद खी बने हुए अपने नोकर चाकरों के साथ

verses.sloka: अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय ।अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे न निवेदयसे यदि ।। ७.१०५.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: asminkṣaṇe māṁ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya ।asminkṣaṇe māṁ saumitre na nivedayase yadi ।। 7.105.6 ॥

translations.english: The sage commanded, "O son of Sumitra, announce me to Rama this very moment; if you do not announce me to Rama this very moment, O son of Sumitra..."
translations.hindi: ला: रा? ० १९ errr SITES एण्ड रा जा ७5 णा _. उसी बन में घुस कर बह कमल्षनयनी स्त्री बन, पेदल हो घुमने फिरने लगा | इस बन में अनेक बृक्ष, लता और गुल्म आदि की मनोहर शोभा हो रही थी

verses.sloka: विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा ।भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ।। ७.१०५.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣayaṁ tvāṁ puraṁ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṁ tathā ।bharataṁ caiva saumitre yuṣmākaṁ yā ca santatiḥ ।। 7.105.7 ॥

translations.english: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.

verses.sloka: न हि शक्ष्याम्यहं भूयो मन्युं धारयितुं हृदि ।तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसङ्काशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः ।चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम् ।। ७.१०५.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmyahaṁ bhūyo manyuṁ dhārayituṁ hṛdi ।tacchrutvā ghorasaṅkāśaṁ vākyaṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ ।cintayāmāsa manasā tasya vākyasya niścayam ।। 7.105.8 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the terrible words of that great soul, he pondered in his mind the definite meaning of that statement, realizing he could no longer contain his anger.

verses.sloka: एकस्य मरणं मे ऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम् ।इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ७.१०५.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekasya maraṇaṁ me 'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam ।iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat ।। 7.105.9 ॥

translations.english: Deciding with his intellect that it was better for one person to die than for everyone to be destroyed, he reported this to Rama.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च ।निस्सृत्य त्वरितं राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह ।। ७.१०५.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṁ visṛjya ca ।nissṛtya tvaritaṁ rājā atreḥ putraṁ dadarśa ha ।। 7.105.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Lakshmana's words, King Rama dismissed Kala and quickly came out to see the son of Atri.
translations.hindi: वे उसी तालाब के जल के भीतर खड़े हुए उप्न तप कर रहे थे। वे बड़े यशस्वी, परोपकारी और दयालु जान पड़ते थें

verses.sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ।। ७.१०५.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā ।kiṁ kāryamiti kākutsthaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata ।। 7.105.11 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the great soul who was blazing with splendor, Rama, with folded hands, asked what his purpose was.
translations.hindi: । & € हें लक्ष्मण ! कुछ देर के बाद इला खी ने ख्रोरूपी अपने साथियों के साथ उस सरोबर पर जा ओर विस्मित हो, उघ सरोबर का जल खलबला डाला

verses.sloka: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुम् ।प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल ।। ७.१०५.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadvākyaṁ rāghaveṇoktaṁ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhum ।pratyāha rāmaṁ durvāsāḥ śrūyatāṁ dharmavatsala ।। 7.105.12 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those words spoken by Rama, the best of sages, Durvasa, replied to the lord, saying, "O lover of righteousness, listen."
translations.hindi: इला को देख, बुध कामदेव से पीड़ित दो, अपने को न सम्हाल सके ओर जल के भातर चलायमान हो गए

verses.sloka: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिस्तपसो मम ।सो ऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ।। ७.१०५.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: adya varṣasahasrasya samāptistapaso mama ।so 'haṁ bhojanamicchāmi yathāsiddhaṁ tavānagha ।। 7.105.13 ॥

translations.english: O sinless one, today marks the completion of my thousand-year penance, and so I desire whatever food is ready to break my fast.
translations.hindi: त्रेलोक्यसुन्दरी इला को ओर देख कर, बुध मन द्दी सन कहने लगे कि, यह देबाब्नना से भी बढ़ कर सुन्दरी खरो कोन है

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं राजा राघवः प्रीतमानसः ।भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत् ।। ७.१०५.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā vacanaṁ rājā rāghavaḥ prītamānasaḥ ।bhojanaṁ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat ।। 7.105.14 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that word, King Rama, with a pleased mind, offered food to the chief of sages as it was prepared.

verses.sloka: स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् ।साधु रामेति सम्भाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत् ।। ७.१०५.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu bhuktvā muniśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam ।sādhu rāmeti sambhāṣya svamāśramamupāgamat ।। 7.105.15 ॥

translations.english: Having eaten that nectar-like food, the best of sages praised Rama saying "Excellent, Rama!" and then returned to his own hermitage.
translations.hindi: यदि इसका विवाह किसी पुरुष के साथ न हुआ, तो यह मेरे योग्य है । यह विचार कर बुध जा जल से निकल ठट पर आए

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् गते मुनिवरे स्वाश्रमं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।संस्मृत्य कालवाक्यानि ततो दुःखमुपागमत् ।। ७.१०५.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin gate munivare svāśramaṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।saṁsmṛtya kālavākyāni tato duḥkhamupāgamat ।। 7.105.16 ॥

translations.english: After that excellent sage had returned to his hermitage, Rama, the elder brother of Lakshmana, remembered the words of Kala and was then overcome with sorrow.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌! यह खी हम सब दी स्वामिनी हे । इसका पति नहीं है.। यह हमारे साथ इस बन के प्रान्तों में 'बिचरती रहती ' है

verses.sloka: दुःखेन च सुसन्तप्तः स्मृत्वा तद्घोरदर्शनम् ।अवाङ्मुखो दीनमना व्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।। ७.१०५.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: duḥkhena ca susantaptaḥ smṛtvā tadghoradarśanam ।avāṅmukho dīnamanā vyāhartuṁ na śaśāka ha ।। 7.105.17 ॥

translations.english: Deeply distressed by sorrow and remembering that terrible sight, he became downcast and dejected, unable to utter a word.

verses.sloka: ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः ।नैतदस्तीति निश्चित्य तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः ।। ७.१०५.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato buddhyā viniścitya kālavākyāni rāghavaḥ ।naitadastīti niścitya tūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.105.18 ।।

translations.english: Then, the greatly renowned Rama, having intellectually ascertained the words of Kala and deciding that "this is not (to be avoided)", remained silent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 105 ।। Thus ends the hundred and fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
